§1 Rhyme suggestion filter: identity check fail on both of yours, tier walk pass, mosaic present, cliche scan pass.

**Identity check first.** re-LEASE, po-LICE and LEASE all put the same l in front of the same stressed ee-s. That's identity, not rhyme: the ear hears one word three times. So neither police nor lease; here is a menu instead.

| Tier | Candidate | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Perfect | *peace* | resolved, risks the cliche pairing |
| Perfect | *grease* | the car, the road |
| Perfect | *decrease* | slows the line down |
| Family | *beef* | s to f, same voiceless family |
| Family | *wreath* | s to th, a funeral shadow |
| Additive | *east* | adds the t, a direction to drive |
| Assonance | *seat* | the empty passenger seat |
| Assonance | *keep* | vowel only, stays open |
| Mosaic | *the streets* | multi-word, keeps the motion |
| Mosaic | *on my knees* | multi-word, voiced z, a turn of feeling |

Which one depends on whether the chorus should land or stay restless. The pick is yours.
Police and lease are identities, not rhymes: same l, same stressed vowel.
